lines: Runs the default train rollout, then for every group in which no sample got the question right (up to
--rescue-max-groups per step) runs the projection sampler with the gold query shown in the prompt as a hint. A passing
-trajectory replaces one failed sample of the group, so the group gets a learning signal. Eval is unchanged.
+trajectory replaces one failed sample of the group, so the group gets a learning signal. Eval generation is
+otherwise unchanged. Every train/eval rollout first flushes the engine's prefix cache, which the in-place
+weight update leaves populated with entries computed under older weights (see `flush_engine_cache`).
